entries.title: Florida sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over alleged 'exploitation of users'
entries.summary: Florida's lawsuit against OpenAI comes after a mass shooter at FSU reportedly consulted ChatGPT to plan the attack.
entries.excerpt: Florida's Attorney General has sued OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman,according to a report byNBC News. The suit accuses the company of pushing a product it knew could harm users. "The rise of OpenAI is attributable to a web of deceit and the exploitation of users (including Floridians), leveraging their data and safety to boost OpenAI's market value at unacceptable costs," the complaint reads.
